ns2:course.label: Lab Animal Science I
ns2:course.description: (V C M 346) Addresses fundamental issues in Laboratory Animal Sciences including history, regulatory aspects, ethical considerations, and basic biology and husbandry of common laboratory animal species. Same as ANSC 455. 1 graduate or professional hour. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Second or third-year standing in the veterinary professional curriculum, registration in the graduate college, or consent of instructor.
